name: El Salvador

flag.description: Three equal horizontal bands of blue, white and blue, with the coat of arms in the centre: a triangle containing five volcanoes, a cap of liberty and a rainbow, surrounded by flags and a laurel wreath, encircled by the words "REPUBLICA DE EL SALVADOR EN LA AMERICA CENTRAL".
flag.symbolism: The blue bands represent the Pacific Ocean and the Caribbean Sea and white the land and peace; the five volcanoes stand for the members of the former Federal Republic of Central America.

hook: El Salvador frames its volcano triangle with five flags and a green laurel wreath; Nicaragua uses only gold lettering, and Honduras just stars.
trivia: The national motto "Dios, Unión, Libertad" (God, Union, Liberty) appears on the coat of arms.
El Salvador is the smallest country in mainland Central America by area.
In 2021 El Salvador became the first country to make Bitcoin legal tender.
